name: release-coast2
description: The v0.0.36 release build (rc and final): the release recipe plus the whole coastline on CHIM - coast2, the closed ring (rings 1 and 2: 325 region cells, 222 land + 103 seabed; 6 more inside the Seyda Neen and Vivec city frames) - with Balmora, Seyda Neen, the whole city of Vivec and the Bitter Coast town on CHIM, compiled terrain hulls and terrain references. The status input comes from a CHIMport run (see its "how"); point the recipe at your own with --recipe-input ROLE=PATH. Run it with --developer-mode, as release builds are.

inputs.how: The CHIM progress tracker file of the CHIMport run that closed the coast2 ring: TRACKER/cell-progress.json, written by python3 tools/cell_progress.py ingest (docs/chim/PROGRESS_TRACKER.md); python3 tools/chim/regions.py coast2 --status cell-progress.json lists the 325 cells
